authority_boundary: Trust tiers lower intake friction only. Every external item still passes screening (prompt injection, license, provenance, compatibility) and a named human approval before promotion. A tier never authorizes copying external content into DAD or downstream repos.

trust_tiers.high_signal: Frontier labs, professional security firms, and language foundations with strong review culture; intake allowed without extra justification.
trust_tiers.known: Curated community sources with real editorial filtering; intake allowed without extra justification but screen skeptically.
trust_tiers.unknown: Everything else; intake requires an explicit written justification.

sources.label: Anthropic (engineering blog, docs, official repos)
intake_actions: Record pointer-only candidates; route coding-review ideas to harness discovery.

sources.label: OpenAI (blog, developers site, official repos)
intake_actions: Record pointer-only candidates; cite official docs before OpenAI implementation changes.

sources.label: Trail of Bits (security skills, Testing Handbook)
intake_actions: Prefer harness ideas and red-team rubrics; do not copy third-party skill bodies.

sources.label: Google (Comprehensive Rust, official org repos)
intake_actions: Route reusable language guidance through research intake as pointer-only docs.

sources.label: Rust project (official docs, blogs, RFCs, crates, project goals)
frontier_watch: new stabilized language and stdlib features
RFCs affecting API design, async, unsafe boundaries, or performance
crates that improve deterministic scanning, parsing, hashing, or static analysis
intake_actions: Update Rust buildout guidance only after screening and a human-reviewed DAD promotion.
Prefer small harness experiments before recommending Rust in downstream repos.

sources.label: Rust community frontier feeds (This Week in Rust, performance book, Tokio blog)
frontier_watch: anti-patterns that AI agents may miss because they are underrepresented in generic code corpora
intake_actions: Create research-intake records for candidate crates or idioms; keep claims candidate-only until DAD evals exist.
Translate repeated patterns into harness research questions instead of direct style rules.

sources.label: RustSec and Rust security advisory sources
intake_actions: Route security-relevant changes to governance notices or harness checks; never auto-upgrade dependencies by mail.

sources.label: PyO3 / maturin project
intake_actions: Update Python-to-Rust guidance only after parity and packaging checks.

sources.label: Python core project (PEPs, dev guide, core discussions, CPython)
frontier_watch: new or accepted PEPs affecting language features, typing, packaging, performance, or concurrency
stdlib features underused by AI agents
deprecations that should update DAD Python guidance
intake_actions: Update Python idiom cards through screened pointer records and regression examples.
Do not treat a PEP draft as an adopted rule until status and target version are reviewed.

sources.label: Python Packaging Authority and PyPI
intake_actions: Route packaging changes to Python harnesses and repo template recommendations after screening.

sources.label: Astral (ruff, uv)
intake_actions: Evaluate speed/tooling changes through DAD harnesses before recommending repo-wide adoption.

sources.label: martinfowler.com articles
intake_actions: Promote only as pointer-only architecture or lesson candidates.
